title: Evaluation of the ordinary system tensor comparison
statement: Let J and J' be Grothendieck sites with essentially small underlying categories, B a sequence of coefficient sheaves with transition maps tau, and O an ordinary geometric system calculus. Let T be GeometryOrdinaryTensor for O [lem-coef-semilinear-geometric-ordinary-tensor]. For every index n and systems M,N, evaluating T.system(M,N).hom equals the hom of geometricTensorComponent(O,T.level,n,M,N) [lem-coef-geometric-tensor-component-horizontal]. The equality uses the specified ordinaryPullEvaluation and ordinaryEvaluationTensor isomorphisms, with no extra assumption on transitions or preservation of products.

source.place: clause (2), finite unit and tensor maps and their transposes

proof.text: The defining evaluation square T.evaluation and the proved component_square equation have the same right side. Cancel the composite of ordinaryEvaluationTensor.hom and the tensor of the two ordinaryPullEvaluation.hom maps; both are isomorphisms. The remaining morphisms are the asserted evaluations. The other proved private helpers in the module apply component_pure to the generalized product pairing, use naturality of a given section family, and transport this equality through siteTensorIso and the evaluation section casts. No product-preservation hypothesis is needed for this particular generalized pair.

proof_origin.place: Clause (2); complete Lean proof of the finite tensor and adjunction coordinate step.

theorem tensorComparison_evaluation (n : ℕ) (M N : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) :
    (evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition n).map
        (T.system M N).hom =
      (geometricTensorComponent.{c, v, r} J B τ J' L P a O T.level n M N).hom
